name: TEAMSTR
recent: Teamstar Berhad 宣布 2026 财年第一次中期股息每股 0.50 仙，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 15 日，派发日为 2026 年 9 月 30 日。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 11.0%，净利环比大幅上升至 350.5 万令吉，净利率由 1.6% 提升至 9.5%。此外，公司于 9 月 18 日更换公司秘书并更改注册地址。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年第一次中期股息每股 0.50 仙。

recent_en: Teamstar Berhad declared a first interim dividend of 0.50 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 15 September 2026 and payment date on 30 September 2026. Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 11.0% QoQ, while net profit jumped to MYR 3.505 million and net margin improved from 1.6% to 9.5%. The company also changed its company secretary and registered address on 18 September.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.50 sen per share for FY2026.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose sharply QoQ to MYR 3.505 million.
Changed company secretary and registered address.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 36.832 million, up 11.0% QoQ; net profit was MYR 3.505 million, up 577.9% QoQ; net margin was 9.5%, higher than 1.6% in the previous quarter.
